# Freesound

Kenney RPG Audio has no wildlife loops. This folder was going to hold CC0 Freesound clips (seagulls, tropical birds, pig, splash).

Freesound’s API needs a logged-in token, so clips were **not** downloaded.

Environment and animal audio now live under [`../opengameart/`](../opengameart/) (CC0 OpenGameArt packs). See [`../opengameart/AUDIO_INDEX.md`](../opengameart/AUDIO_INDEX.md). Re-fetch with `scripts/fetch-opengameart-audio.py`.
